sovereign_country.strategic_role: 支持全中文章程、传统华人客群离岸家族信托常驻地

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Legal Accounting Defense for International Anti-Dumping Inquiries

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Samoa (International Companies Registry, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Common Law (English common law as constitutionally received, with customary land-tenure overlay)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PACER Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus, in force for Samoa since 2020)
Tax Information Exchange Agreement with Australia (in force)
Tax Information Exchange Agreement with New Zealand (in force)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Money Laundering Prevention Act 2018 (No. 32 of 2018) as amended by the Money Laundering Prevention (Amendment) Act 2021; Financial Intelligence Unit Act 2018; International Companies Act 2019 (No. 39 of 2019), Parts 2 and 4 (incorporation, registered agents, registers, and beneficial ownership records); International Companies (Fees) Regulations; AML/CFT guidelines issued by the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit under the Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering (APG) mutual evaluation framework

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the proposed Memorandum and Articles of Association (English governing text with full Chinese translation annexed)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public of the jurisdiction of origin (e.g., People's Republic of China Notary Public Office)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Samoa is not a Contracting Party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention as of the 2024 filing window; chain: home-country notary attestation, PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs attestation, then legalization by the Samoan High Commission or Honorary Consulate)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency and extract of the Register of Directors and Beneficial Owners maintained by the registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Certification by the licensed Samoa registered agent, accepted by the Samoa Companies Registry without external apostille for internal registry and bank opening purposes

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Passport copies and proof of residential address of each director, shareholder, and ultimate beneficial owner (UBO)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public of the UBO's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (home-country notary + foreign affairs office attestation + Samoan diplomatic or consular legalization where available)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing of any corporate shareholder or ultimate parent entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry of the shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where the shareholder registry is in a Contracting State (e.g., Hong Kong SAR, Singapore) OR Consular Legalization for other jurisdictions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: AML/CFT source-of-funds and source-of-wealth questionnaire with bank reference letter
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Principal bank of the settlor or investor, countersigned by the licensed registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized bank confirmation accepted as certified due-diligence evidence; no apostille required for the registered agent's internal CDD file

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, and UBOs under Part 3 of the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2018: (i) identification and verification of beneficial ownership before incorporation; (ii) risk-based enhanced due diligence (EDD) for politically exposed persons (PEPs), immediate family, and close associates; (iii) screening against the UN Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU consolidated sanctions list, and UK FCDO sanctions list; and (iv) ongoing transaction monitoring aligned with Samoa FIU guidance and APG recommendations. All screening results must be documented in the registered agent's CDD file and made available to the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit upon lawful demand.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa Companies Registry (Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour) online name search and incorporation portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The registered name must be expressed in Roman script; a foreign-language (Chinese) name may be adopted only as an annexed translation of the Roman-script registered name and does not operate as a separate registered name. A full Chinese-language Memorandum and Articles of Association is permitted as a certified translation annexed to the English governing instrument, provided the English version prevails in any inconsistency.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the licensed registered agent files a written request for reconsideration with the Principal Registrar of Companies (MCIL) within 14 calendar days, attaching a statutory declaration on distinguishability and written consent letters from any conflicting registered name holder. If the Registrar maintains the refusal, an administrative appeal is available to the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour, with a further appeal or judicial review before the Supreme Court of Samoa within 21 days of the final refusal decision. A reserved name may be extended for one additional 30-day period upon written application and payment of the prescribed extension fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A pure virtual office is not permissible as a substitute for the statutory registered office. Every International Company must maintain a registered office and a licensed registered agent at a physical street address in Samoa under the International Companies Act 2019, Part 4. The company itself is not required to maintain personnel or premises in Samoa; the licensed agent's premises serve as the statutory registered office, which is the accepted substance model for a non-resident offshore trade-defense consulting company without local economic footprint.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (approximately 5%): unannounced on-site inspections are risk-targeted at licensed registered agents on an annual cycle by the Registrar and the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit, not at non-resident international companies. Inspection risk to the company itself rises to approximately 20% if it later establishes physical operations, employs local staff, or obtains a Samoa business license.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance and availability certificate (company name search)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the International Companies (Fees) Regulations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Incorporation filing fee for an International Company (standard share capital; no minimum paid-up capital)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the International Companies (Fees) Regulations; prevailing market range USD 290-450

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certificate of Incorporation, certified copies of constitutional documents, and registered agent certificates
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Samoa Companies Registry / licensed registered agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory certification fee plus licensed agent handling charge

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: First-year licensed registered agent and registered office service fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark of USD 750-1,200 per annum depending on agent tier and compliance scope

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO register establishment, customer due diligence file, and PEP/OFAC/UN sanctions screening
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed registered agent / external EDD screening vendor
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for risk-based onboarding and Refinitiv/World-Check or equivalent continuous monitoring

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and consular legalization of constitution, UBO identification documents, and authentication chain (China or Hong Kong origin documents)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public office, PRC Foreign Affairs Office, and Samoan diplomatic or consular post
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notary tariff and prevailing consular fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal due-diligence opinion and anti-dumping trade-defense license gap analysis (ISIC 7490 / NAICS 541199)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for UBO piercing review and admissibility assessment of a Samoan International Company in foreign anti-dumping proceedings

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (as amended), sections 6, 9, 11, 15, and 78; Business Licences Act 2016 (for operating licence)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Samoa International Companies Registry, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Certificate of Incorporation application on Form A with certified Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital requirement; shares may be issued for such consideration as the board determines; escrow account rules do not apply to Samoan International Companies.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, by unanimous written consent of the subscriber to the memorandum of the International Company, effective as of the date of incorporation, that: 1. The subscription to the issued shares as stated in the Statement of Capital is accepted and deemed allotted to the Subscriber named therein. 2. The registered office of the Company be fixed at the address designated by the licensed registered agent, which shall be maintained within Samoa. 3. The individuals named in the schedule be and are hereby appointed as the first directors; such appointment takes effect immediately. 4. The directors are authorized to open bank accounts, appoint corporate officers, and take all matters necessary to commence business.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Clearance and Registered Agent Appointment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa International Companies Registry, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File a name clearance request through the MCIL online lodgement portal or by written submission; concurrently engage a licensed Samoa registered agent to maintain the registered office and statutory records.
required_dossiers: Letter of engagement from licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is rejected as undesirable or confusingly similar, file a new name request with a revised proposed name within 5 business days; no resubmission fee applies for the first re-filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarization of Charter Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered agent of Samoa or Samoa notary public
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English, including share capital, restrictive and permitted objects, and names of initial directors; sign by the subscriber and have the signature notarized if required.
required_dossiers: Statement of share capital and subscribers
Consent of first directors to act
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar objects to any clause, submit an amendment or supplemental document within 10 business days; obtain written approval before re-filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission to Companies Registry and Payment of Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa International Companies Registry, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the duly executed charter package via the online lodgement portal or at the Registry counter; pay the statutory incorporation filing fee and stamp duty by credit card, bank draft, or SWIFT wire to the MCIL account.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is made incorrect or incomplete, the Registry issues a query; complete the response online within 14 days and resubmit any refused documents; additional fees may apply after three failed attempts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Extract
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation and a certified extract of the company register; maintain these original documents in the company minute book and transmit the corporate details to the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If there is a clerical error in the certificate, file a request for correction of the register with supporting evidence; the Registrar issues an amended certificate within 7 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors in coordination with licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Approve the first board resolution in the company minute book; issue share certificates to subscribers; appoint managing director and company secretary; adopt a common seal if desired; maintain statutory registers and secure bank account opening authorities.
required_dossiers: Minute book and index of resolutions
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any defect in director appointment or share issuance is identified, pass a further board resolution ratifying the appointment or issuance; notify the Registrar if statutory registers require amendment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business Licences Division, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the Business Licence under the Business Licences Act 2016, attaching the Certificate of Incorporation and particulars of the intended trade remedy defense activities; this is an obligatory precondition to trading.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the licence application is declined, seek an administrative review with MCIL and resubmit after amending the business activities description; the licence term is one year and renewal is due annually.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour – Business Licences Division
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business Licence under the Business Licences Act 2016 (Category: Professional and Technical Services)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment, Environment Sector Division
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – purely advisory use of licensed office premises; no full EIA Report or registration required
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Nil industrial wastewater discharge (office use only); sanitary effluent must comply with Samoa Sewerage Regulations; paper waste and e-waste handled under the Waste Management Act 2010; air emissions limited to negligible office ventilation.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority; structural load inspection and certificate of occupancy for the registered office; occupational safety and health clearance from the Ministry of Health under the Occupational Health and Safety Rules 2015.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry for Revenue of Samoa (MFRS) - taxpayer registration and filing portal: https://www.revenue.gov.ws (online TIN assignment and e-services portal)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned International Company (IC) must obtain a Samoan Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) by filing Form TIN-01 with the Ministry for Revenue. Required supporting documentation: Certificate of Incorporation or continuation certificate, Memorandum and Articles of Association, registered office and registered agent details, board resolution appointing a tax representative, passport or national ID copies of directors and shareholders, and proof of registered address in Samoa. Submission is made through the MFRS e-services portal or through a licensed registered agent. The TIN is normally issued within 1-3 business days. The same TIN is used for VAGST registration; an IC whose taxable supplies exceed the statutory threshold must file Form VAGST-01 using the same TIN.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone - International Company automatically exempt from Samoan income tax on non-resident-source income under the International Companies Act 1987; territorial scope limited to Samoa-sourced income; no entity-level taxation for offshore business activities
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: N/A. Samoa does not operate a US-style check-the-box regime. The International Company tax exemption is automatic under the International Companies Act 1987 and may be evidenced by a tax exemption certificate issued by the Ministry for Revenue. No check-the-box election or hybrid mismatch election is available to an International Company in Samoa.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: SAT$100,000 (WST 100,000) annual taxable turnover; mandatory registration applies to any person making or intending to make taxable supplies exceeding SAT$100,000 in any 12-month period, with registration effective from the date the threshold is exceeded
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, digital stamping, or government API-based clearance mandate is currently in force in Samoa. VAGST-registered persons must issue valid tax invoices containing prescribed particulars (supplier name and TIN, recipient name and TIN, invoice date, description, quantity, VAGST-exclusive amount, VAGST amount, and total consideration), retain supporting records for at least 7 years, and file VAGST returns electronically through the MFRS e-services portal.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods: VAGST zero-rating applies to goods physically exported from Samoa by the supplier and retained outside Samoa until the export is complete. Services: zero-rating applies to services supplied to a non-resident recipient who is outside Samoa at the time of supply, where the services are not connected with land or goods situated in Samoa and are performed wholly outside Samoa or otherwise exported. Trade remedy defense and anti-dumping inquiry consulting services supplied to offshore principals qualify where the benefit and use of the services occur outside Samoa. The supplier must retain contemporaneous evidence of the offshore recipient and non-consumption of the services in Samoa; input tax credits may be claimed to the extent attributable to the zero-rated supply.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Samoa Customs Service electronic export entry/SGD)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical export and destination outside Samoa
Inward Remittance Certificate issued by a licensed Samoan commercial bank or SWIFT MT103 evidencing receipt of foreign currency in Samoa
Tax invoice and signed contract evidencing the offshore nature of the recipient and the exact service description
Service completion report, correspondence logs, or work product demonstating performance outside Samoa
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Samoa Ministry for Revenue may audit zero-rating claims and require complete documentary proof. Failure to substantiate export status results in disallowance of zero-rating, immediate recovery of unpaid VAGST, interest, and late-payment penalties. False, misleading, or fraudulent export zero-rating claims constitute an offence under the VAGST Act 2008 and the Tax Administration Act, punishable by monetary penalties of up to SAT$100,000 and/or imprisonment. Principals and directors may be jointly and severally liable. Retrospective clawback can extend to all wrongfully claimed input tax credits plus penalties up to 200% of the tax evaded.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS), established under the Central Bank of Samoa Act 1984; foreign-exchange administration is exercised under the Exchange Control Act 1975 and the Exchange Control Regulations. The CBS alone issues exchange-control licences to authorised dealers (commercial banks), maintains the official WST exchange-rate basket against a trade-weighted set of partner currencies, and oversees the national AML/CFT supervision of banks through the Financial Intelligence Unit established under the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Samoa operates a managed-float exchange-rate regime for the Samoan Tala (WST). The CBS sets and announces the daily reference rate against a basket of principal trading-partner currencies (USD, AUD, NZD, EUR and JPY) and intervenes through authorised dealers to smooth volatility. Current-account payments are substantially liberalised: trade-in-services remittances (legal, consulting and trade-defense representation fees) are executed by authorised dealers on submission of the underlying contract, invoice and a standard CBS application form, without prior CBS approval in routine cases. Capital-account transactions, including foreign direct investment, external borrowing and portfolio flows, remain controlled and require CBS authorisation on a documented, case-by-case basis. A Samoa International Company (IC) is treated as non-resident for exchange-control purposes and maintains only foreign-currency offshore accounts; its convertibility profile therefore approximates a free offshore account, with the practical hurdles being documentary proof of economic substance, full beneficial-ownership disclosure and absence of transactions with Samoan residents. Dividend and capital repatriation by a tax-exempt IC is free of Samoa withholding tax and free of mandatory WST conversion, provided the annual IC licence fee has been paid and the remittance is supported by the IC tax-exemption certificate, the authorised dealer's outward-remittance declaration, and compliance with the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 reporting thresholds.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the Exchange Control Regulations, proceeds of exports of goods must be collected within six (6) months from the date of final shipment and remitted through a bank in Samoa licensed as an authorised dealer, unless CBS grants a specific extension. The statutory credit ratio is the full 100 per cent of the invoice value; however, the exporter may hold the proceeds in a designated foreign-currency account with an authorised dealer without conversion into WST. For a Samoa International Company earning invisible earnings (professional fees for anti-dumping and trade-defense advisory services), the same six-month collection rule applies from the invoice date; the inward remittance is credited to the IC's multi-currency account and does not trigger any WST conversion because the entire operating currency is foreign. Any shortfall, delay, write-off or netting of receivables must be declared to both the authorised dealer and CBS, accompanied by evidence of the collection measures taken; non-compliance is an offence under the Exchange Control Act 1975.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) Samoa Limited (successor to Westpac Samoa; the largest CBS-licensed commercial bank in Samoa with Pacific-wide SWIFT and correspondent-banking network)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (verification of shareholder injection) / Operational Multi-Currency Offshore Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Samoa Commercial Bank Limited (SCB), a locally incorporated licensed bank suitable for operational accounts introduced through a resident registered agent

ANZ Bank (Samoa) Limited (institutional and international banking desk; onboarding feasibility must be re-confirmed at time of application given the previously announced transfer of ANZ's Samoan retail, commercial and SME portfolio to BSP)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW-MEDIUM. Samoa has no domestic digital-bank or electronic-money-institution licensing regime, and most offshore UK, EU and Singapore EMIs will decline a Samoan International Company because of residual reputational concern linked to offshore IC structures and Samoa's historical presence on EU screening lists. The workable model is to maintain the primary treasury relationship with a CBS-licensed authorised dealer (BSP platform preferred) and to use an OECD-licensed EMI only as a supplementary receivables-collection wallet for fee income from low-risk clients in the EU, UK and Australasia. Legal constraints: the IC is prohibited from transacting with Samoan residents or using the WST domestic payment infrastructure, so the EMI must operate purely as a non-resident collection and disbursement point for foreign-currency flows routed onward to the Samoan bank account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Samoa does not statutorily require all directors to appear in person; remote account opening is permitted under the CBS AML/CFT framework provided that: (i) a licensed registered agent in Apia (International Companies Act 1987) certifies the corporate record and the signatory mandate; (ii) the bank performs a live video-identification interview with each director and every beneficial owner holding 25 per cent or more; (iii) notarised passport copies are apostilled or legally certified and delivered by courier to the Apia branch; and (iv) the physically executed banking mandate is lodged through the registered agent. In practice, the registered agent's nominee or at least one executive director is required to attend a single account-signing ceremony at the branch, with subsequent signatories onboarded remotely.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt International Company with nominee directors assessed as a potential shell vehicle; insufficient beneficial-ownership transparency at account-opening review.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full beneficial-ownership register tracing the entire ownership chain; certificate of incorporation; certificate of good standing; current IC annual licence fee receipt; tax-exemption certificate; board resolution describing the active trade-defense consultancy; registered-office lease and substance file; professional-indemnity insurance certificate; and a signed undertaking to notify the bank of any change of control within 14 days.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Anti-dumping defence client base comprises manufacturers in emerging and higher-risk jurisdictions, triggering enhanced country-risk and sanctions screening at onboarding and on each transaction.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Pre-engagement sanctions, PEP and adverse-media screening reports; full client roster with ultimate beneficial owners; executed engagement letters for each matter (initiation notification, questionnaire responses, verification assistance and WTO dispute defense); fee invoices with payment trail; and a commitment to provide quarterly source-of-funds and downstream-transaction reports to the bank's compliance committee.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Initial deposit derived from shareholder funds in a pre-revenue enterprise; inconclusive source-of-funds documentation presented at account opening.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Shareholder source-of-wealth letter supported by recent bank statements; SWIFT MT103 audit trail of the capital injection; business plan and fee-pipeline projection for trade-defense work; executed shareholder-loan agreement (if subordinated debt is used) with market-rate interest; and an undertaking that the initial deposit will be applied exclusively to Samoan licence fees, professional subscriptions and escrow deposits for tribunal payments.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Historic association of Samoan ICs with bearer shares and statutory confidentiality; bank compliance committee requires independent legal assurance on the capital structure.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Legal opinion from Samoan-qualified counsel confirming compliance with the International Companies Act 1987 (as amended), including cancellation or immobilisation of any bearer instruments; registered-agent certification of the register of members; declaration of no outstanding bearer securities; confirmation of good standing from the Registrar of International Companies; and a Financial Intelligence Unit enquiry certificate where requested by the bank.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital contribution is routed by SWIFT MT103 with reference text 'IC Capital Contribution - [company name]', accompanied by the bank's inward-remittance declaration. The receiving authorised dealer credits the IC's multi-currency account after verifying: (i) the board resolution approving the share allotment or subordinated loan; (ii) an excerpt from the register of members or the executed loan agreement; (iii) source-of-funds evidence from the remitting shareholder; and (iv) sanctions screening of the remitter and all intermediary banks. Because the IC holds non-resident offshore status and no WST is involved, prior CBS authorisation is not required; the bank applies the standard statistical purpose code (current-account transfer / professional-services credit) for CBS reporting and files a threshold report with the Financial Intelligence Unit where applicable under the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007. Settlement timing: same-day for local Samoan Tala balances; T+1 to T+2 for USD legs via United States correspondent banks; T+1 for EUR, AUD and GBP legs through the bank's European, Australian and UK correspondents respectively.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound payments for trade-defense work (foreign counsel retainers, expert-witness fees, WTO and anti-dumping authority filing fees, translation and certification costs) are settled via: (i) SWIFT MT103 customer credit transfers for individual beneficiaries, each matched to an underlying invoice retained on file for five years; (ii) MT202 COV for correspondent interbank reimbursement where a local intermediary is used; (iii) ACH (USD, EUR, GBP) for recurring low-value fees if offered by the host bank; and (iv) standby documentary credits (MT760, or commercial LC MT700 where a counsel or tribunal requires payment security), supported by a segregated cash escrow within the same bank. All disbursements are exclusively in foreign currency to non-resident beneficiaries; settlement in WST to Samoan residents is impermissible for an International Company without a specific CBS derogation. Each payment must pass sanctions screening, be traceable to the underlying engagement letter and invoice, and support the bank's statutory record-keeping and suspicious-transaction reporting obligations.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore spot FX contracts with CBS-licensed authorised dealers (WST legs limited to payment of Samoan regulatory fees and bank charges; speculative WST trading is prohibited for an International Company)
Documentary forward contracts with the authorised dealer or its offshore parent (maximum tenor 12 months, renewable), supported by a genuine future trade-defense receivable or payable
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing WST, executed with OECD-headquartered counterparties to hedge residual administrative-cost exposure without requiring settlement in WST
Cross-currency swaps (USD/EUR/GBP/AUD) for balance-sheet asset-liability matching and working-capital certainty
Natural hedging through multi-currency current and deposit accounts (USD, EUR, AUD, GBP, NZD) to minimise conversion frequency and avoid mandatory WST conversion
Prohibited and outside board policy: exotic options, structured products with embedded leverage, cryptocurrency-linked instruments, and any derivative creating a Samoan-resident counterparty leg

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: International Company Annual Renewal and Government Fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa International Financial Services Authority (SIFSA) – Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the incorporation anniversary; calendar-year renewal payment must be completed no later than 30 June of each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment penalty of 10% per month or part of a month, capped at 100% of the annual fee; continued non-payment may result in administrative strike-off after official notice and publication in the Samoa Gazette

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent Annual UBO and Statutory Register Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa International Financial Services Authority (SIFSA) through the appointed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually with the renewal filing, no later than 30 June; updated within 14 days of any share transfer or director change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failures or false confirmations are treated as compliance defaults under anti-money-laundering rules; the registered agent may report the default to SIFSA, and persistent non-compliance may lead to administrative penalties and strike-off of the International Company

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Office and Statutory Register Availability Audit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa International Financial Services Authority (SIFSA) / Registered Agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: At least once per calendar year; statutory registers must be made available for inspection during ordinary business hours
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain statutory registers is an offence under the International Companies Act; the Registrar may impose fines and initiate administrative strike-off for continued default

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit obligation for Samoa International Companies; audits are not compulsory regardless of revenue, assets, or number of shareholders, unless the company's own constitution or a commercial lender, bank, or trade-defense engagement contract requires a certified audit
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No mandatory Samoa Local GAAP for International Companies; IFRS is the accepted voluntary framework for internal or contractual financial statements; records must be sufficient to explain transactions and financial position

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must hold and annually confirm current beneficial ownership information. Each share transfer or change in significant control requires an immediate update to the Register of Members and the beneficial ownership register before the next annual confirmation cycle; the updated register must be available to the registered agent and SIFSA upon request

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 when no statutory audit is required; USD 1,500 - USD 4,500 if a voluntary certified audit is required by client arrangements

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% standard resident company rate under the Income Tax Act 2015; 0% for an International Company (IC) qualifying for exemption under the International Companies Act.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: International Company income is exempt from Samoa income tax, capital gains tax, and stamp duty on international transactions; no exchange control restrictions apply; IC annual licence fee is the principal fixed charge.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return is required for an exempt Samoa International Company. Annual compliance is performed through the 'Annual Renewal Statement and Fee' (Form ICA-AR) filed with the Registrar of Companies via the Samoa Companies Online Registry (MCIL).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The Form ICA-AR must be submitted and the annual government licence fee paid no later than the anniversary of the IC's registration date. A grace period of 21 days is permitted, after which a late penalty accrues.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 – Company Name and Registry Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal name and unique registry number issued on the Samoa International Company Certificate of Incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact registered name and format 'WS-IC-XXXX' as shown in official incorporation documents; any name change must be filed in advance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 – Registered Office Address in Samoa
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical address of the registered office in Samoa, which must not be a post office box.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors should ensure an active Samoa street address is maintained; a c/o address of the licensed registered agent is acceptable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3 – Resident Agent Name and Address
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, licence number, and professional address of the Samoa-licensed registered agent sponsoring the IC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The resident agent must physically sign the filing; a non-resident director may not act as registered agent under Samoa law.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Narrative description of the IC's intended actual business operations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use 'Trade-remedy and anti-dumping defense consulting (ISIC 7490)'. State that all activity is conducted outside Samoa to preserve tax-exempt status.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, nationality, resident/non-resident status, and address of each current director and shareholder.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are permitted; nominee arrangements must be disclosed in a separate beneficial-ownership schedule to the registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement confirming the IC will not derive income from, and will not carry on business in, Samoa.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the company carries on consultancy services from Samoan premises or with Samoa-resident employees, it loses IC tax exemption and must register for Samoa corporate income tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation that the beneficial-ownership register has been updated and is accessible to the registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident ultimate beneficial owners must provide certified identity and address documents to the registered agent; failure is an AML offence.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts a penalty equal to 10% of the annual fee plus WST 5 per day of continued default; if the annual fee remains unpaid for 90 days the Registrar may strike the IC off the register. A struck-off IC cannot enforce contracts or defend itself in an overseas anti-dumping proceeding.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% withholding tax on dividends paid by an exempt Samoa International Company to non-resident shareholders. For a resident Samoa company that is not an International Company, the statutory dividend withholding tax rate is 15% when paid to a non-resident.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Samoa has no comprehensive double tax agreement with most trading partners; an International Company's dividend, interest, and royalty payments are sourced outside Samoa when paid to non-residents, so no treaty relief is required. Where a limited allocation-of-taxing-rights agreement or a relevant DTA applies, the non-resident payee must submit a Samoa Certificate of Residence issued by the Ministry of Revenue together with a Treaty Relief Notification and, if requested, a legal opinion from the payee's jurisdiction, before payment; otherwise statutory withholding rates will apply.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: For an exempt International Company: 0% withholding tax on cross-border royalties and interest paid to non-residents. For resident Samoa companies in general: statutory withholding tax on interest is 15% and on royalties is 15%, unless reduced to 5%–10% under an applicable tax treaty or territorial agreement.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No transfer-pricing documentation threshold applies to a tax-exempt International Company because it has no Samoa taxable income. A resident Samoa company (not an IC) must prepare Local File and Master File documentation when annual related-party cross-border transactions exceed WST 1,000,000. An International Company that fails economic-substance requirements and is reclassified as a domestic resident company will become subject to the same threshold.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable. Samoa's International Companies (Economic Substance) Rules require an IC conducting any geographical core income-generating activity to maintain a real physical office in Samoa, employ individuals in Samoa, hold board meetings in Samoa at least once per fiscal year, and keep all relevant bank statements and contracts at the Samoa registered office. For trade-remedy defense consulting, the core activity is 'provision of management and consulting services' and the IC must demonstrate negotiation, staff, and expenditure decisions made in Samoa. An annual economic-substance declaration must be filed with the Registrar.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: A Samoa International Company files a false exemption declaration, conceals Samoan-source income, or uses backdated invoices to divert trade-defense consulting fees while improperly claiming tax-exempt status.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Immediate revocation of IC status, retroactive taxation of all income, a monetary penalty equal to 200% of the tax evaded or WST 100,000 (whichever is greater), and imprisonment of up to 7 years for the responsible officer.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The officer who signed the false declaration is jointly and severally liable for unpaid tax, civil fines, and may be subject to asset freezing, travel bans, and extradition under Samoa's Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters Act.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company – Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the International Company as a hollow structure with no physical office, no employees in Samoa, no board minutes, and no filed economic-substance declaration, while retaining the IC tax exemption on anti-dumping defense fees.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Loss of tax exemption, mandatory payment of all accrued taxes plus 10% interest per annum, a fine of WST 50,000, and strike-off from the Samoa Registry. If the company was used to create bogus legal defenses, the offending entity may also be disqualified from appearing in foreign anti-dumping proceedings.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The court may pierce the corporate veil and order directors to compensate the IC for misrepresentations to tax authorities and trade tribunals; directors can be personally ordered to restore all distributions made to shareholders, and non-resident directors may be banned from holding an appointment in Samoa.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to identify, verify, maintain, and update the register of beneficial owners, or refusing to disclose the true ultimate principal in an overseas anti-dumping trade defense engagement when requested by Samoa's Financial Intelligence Unit or registered agent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2018, the IC is liable to a fine of up to WST 25,000 per offence, and each defaulting officer is subject to a further fine and imprisonment for up to 5 years; the registered agent's licence may be revoked.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the resident agent are each personally liable for AML penalties; directors who knowingly structure ownership to evade sanctions or anti-circumvention findings may face personal prosecution, confiscation of profits, and restrictions on travelling to EU Member States or the forum country initiating the anti-dumping action.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Preparing, through the Samoa IC, false unit cost calculations, fake purchase invoices, or misleading exporter subsidy evidence submitted in an anti-dumping administrative review in a foreign jurisdiction, thereby causing the review authority to rely on fraudulent submissions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Samoa IC and its principals may be fined up to 10% of the value of the foreign trade-remedy claim or WST 200,000, whichever is higher; the IC's licence is revoked for serious misconduct; and the registered agent may be disbarred from acting for any Samoa company.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally exposed to civil restitution and disgorgement of gains in the foreign anti-dumping jurisdiction, injunctive relief against future conduct, and criminal extradition if the foreign state demonstrates that the Samoa IC was used as a sham vehicle to conceal the true exporter.
